mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases do not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases do not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a strong supply side, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening demand side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of decreasing HOUST and increasing UNRATE does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases do not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.
